findings.summary: Production 380K completed all six sends and five intermediate ACK checks but recovered 8/12 (first two parts 0/2 each; last four parts 2/2 each). The subsequent production 256K control recovered 12/12 (2/2 in every part). All observed outgoing payload hashes matched compilation and all model checks were GPT-6 Pro/max. Graph reads returned 404 and asynchronous terminal-stream/parent-chain evidence remains incomplete; both overall sample statuses remain indeterminate.
findings.interpretation: The 380K result fails the recall criterion. The 256K result is one successful recall control, not a universal input entitlement or native total-window guarantee. These runs do not verify a later 256K-input/128K-output budget or automatic-compaction policy.
